mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, req_id, name, description, status, start_date, target_date, released_at, revision, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id AS reqId, r.name AS projectName, v.id AS versionId, v.name AS versionName, v.status AS versionStatus, v.target_date AS targetDate, v.released_at AS releasedAt, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vt.task_id) FROM version_task vt INNER JOIN task t ON t.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND t.id = vt.task_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vt.version_id = v.id AND t.req_id = v.req_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AS taskCount, (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(vr.published_on, DATE(vr.occurred_at))) FROM version_release vr WHERE vr.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND vr.version_id = v.id AND vr.result = 'success' AND vr.environment = 'production' AND vr.operation IN ('deploy', 'redeploy')) AS latestReleaseDate FROM project_version v INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.workspace_id = v.workspace_id AND r.id = v.req_id WHERE v.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.name, COALESCE(v.target_date, DATE(v.released_at), DATE(v.created_at)) DESC, v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_version (id, workspace_id, req_id, name, description, status, start_date, target_date, released_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{targetDate}, #{releasedAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE project_version SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, start_date = #{startDate}, target_date = #{targetDate}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND revision = #{revision}
UPDATE project_version SET revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_version WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
DELETE FROM project_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_plan SET version_id = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId}
